records.name: account.peppol.response.view.form
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <form string="Peppol Response">
                <field name="peppol_message_uuid"/>
                <field name="response_code"/>
                <field name="peppol_state"/>
                <field name="move_id"/>
            </form>
        </field>

records.name: account.peppol.response.view.list
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <list string="Peppol Responses">
                <field name="peppol_message_uuid"/>
                <field name="response_code"/>
                <field name="peppol_state"/>
                <field name="move_id"/>
            </list>
        </field>

records.name: account.peppol.response.view.form.l10n.fr.pdp
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <field name="response_code" position="after">
                <field name="pdp_ref_response_code"/>
                <field name="pdp_flow_number"/>
                <field name="pdp_issue_date"/>
                <field name="pdp_ref_uuid"/>
                <field name="pdp_status_info"/>
                <field name="pdp_payment_info"/>
            </field>
        </field>

records.name: account.peppol.response.view.list.l10n.fr.pdp
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <field name="response_code" position="after">
                <field name="pdp_ref_response_code" optional="hide"/>
                <field name="pdp_flow_number" optional="hide"/>
                <field name="pdp_issue_date" optional="hide"/>
                <field name="pdp_status_info" optional="hide"/>
                <field name="pdp_ref_uuid" optional="hide"/>
                <field name="pdp_ppf_state" optional="hide"/>
            </field>
        </field>
